mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBLMI_BLOCK_LST ( block_type, block_target, block_reg_usr, block_st_dt, block_status, block_grp_cd, reg_id, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{block_type}, INET_ATON(#{block_target}), #{block_reg_usr}, Sysdate(), #{block_status}, #{block_grp_cd}, #{reg_id}, Sysdate() )
mapper.select:
SELECT hst.seq as seq ,hst.usr_grp_cd as usr_grp_cd ,hst.usr_seq as usr_seq ,hst.usr_id as usr_id ,INET_NTOA(hst.usr_ip) as usr_ip ,hst.work_url as work_url ,hst.work_detail as work_detail ,hst.reg_id as reg_id ,hst.reg_dt as reg_dt ,hst.upd_id as upd_id ,hst.upd_dt as upd_dt ,usr.usr_log_id as usr_nm FROM Tblmi_usr_hst as hst LEFT JOIN TBLMI_USR as usr on hst.usr_id = usr.usr_id
INET_NTOA(hst.usr_ip) like concat('%',#{usr_ip},'%')
and hst.work_detail like concat('%',#{work_detail},'%')
and usr.usr_log_id like concat('%',#{usr_nm},'%')
and usr.usr_id like concat('%',#{usr_id},'%')
and hst.usr_grp_cd = #{usr_grp_cd}
order by hst.reg_dt desc
LIMIT #{firstIndex, javaType=int}, #{recordCountPerPage, javaType=int}
